findings.rule: Color discipline (only theme blues; never Tailwind blues) + Status-color reservation (one color = one meaning)
findings.evidence: This finding is unchanged from the prior run. The anatomy palette is still off-token. Sampled pixels: reflux segment on the diagram is rgb(220,38,38), but the table's reflux rail is --emr-error rgb(229,62,62), so one meaning has two reds. The legend swatches, sampled at 768 and 375 where the legend is visible, are perforator rgb(37,99,235) (Tailwind blue-600, which is prohibited), ablated rgb(22,163,74) and normal rgb(148,163,184). Separately, the drawing toolbar's pen swatches use pastel red, blue and green, the same hues that encode severity on the same diagram.
findings.recommendation: Route the anatomy competency palette through tokens. Reflux uses --emr-error so the diagram and the table row match. Perforator uses a theme-blue token (the --emr-primary family), ablated uses --emr-success, and normal uses a neutral border/text-secondary token. Give the pen swatches neutral and theme-blue options only, or explicitly separate annotation colors from the competency hues, so a hand-drawn red mark cannot be read as reflux.

findings.rule: Density tiers (deep-dive: ONE focal element, rich but still ordered)
findings.evidence: The diagram now sits in a right-hand column beside the segment table, which fixes the prior layout finding. In the full-page capture, however, the diagram deck ends flat at about y=1010. The silhouette is cut off mid-thigh: the calf segments (PTV, PER, GASTROC, SOLEAL, GSV Calf, SSV) and the color legend are not visible, and the deck has no bottom padding or radius. This is probably a sticky column with an inner scroll that a full-page capture cannot show. Even so, in a 900px viewport the clinician sees only about 60% of the leg and no legend unless they scroll inside the column.
findings.recommendation: Fit the whole front view plus the legend inside the sticky column's height at 1440x900. Scale the silhouette to the available height, collapse the drawing toolbar to a single row (select/draw toggle plus an overflow for color, size and undo), and pin the legend under the silhouette so it is always visible.
